## Summary

The site's core traffic problem: it pivoted from **InboxZap** (email cleanup) to **Lumina** (AI meeting assistant) — a full product change — but the SEO/technical surface never finished migrating. I found and fixed concrete, verifiable bugs rather than guessing at content:

**Shipped (all verified with `next build` + a local `next start`, every route now 200):**
- `/features` and `/pricing` had **no source file at all** in this repo (would 404 if deployed), despite being in nav and the sitemap. Rebuilt both.
- `app/layout.tsx` still had the pre-pivot title/description/OG ("InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes") on every page that doesn't set its own metadata. Fixed to Lumina, added matching structured data.
- `/faq` is linked in the header on **every page** and 404s — the only "fix" was a redirect to `/#faq`, an anchor that doesn't exist anywhere. Built a real FAQ page with schema, and used it to honestly address "what happened to InboxZap," since that brand still gets real searches landing on a now-unrelated homepage.
- The blog has shown nothing but "Loading posts…" to users and crawlers — it fetches from `/api/posts`, which 404s even on the live site. Rebuilt as real server-rendered pages (index + 12 individual posts) with correct per-page metadata.
- `sitemap.ts` promised 2 pages that didn't exist and omitted `/faq` and all 12 posts. Fixed.

**Flagged, not touched:** the 12 existing blog posts are 100% about email cleanup — the old product. They pull ~17,000 impressions/month combined but almost no clicks and rank page 4-6, actively diluting the site's relevance for "AI meeting assistant." Per the no-silent-redirect rule, I left this for you to decide (retire vs. rewrite) — see `seo/backlog.md`.

All state lives in `seo/` (context, keyword map built from the GSC export, backlog, log, and `seo/reports/2026-10-14.md`) for the next run to pick up. Next highest-value work, once you weigh in: comparison pages against Otter.ai/Fireflies.ai/Fathom and actual category content — nothing invented there since I don't have real product screenshots/specifics to write from yet.
